messages:
sarah_cs: Quick update on Aventis Capital onboarding — account health dipped 8 -> 6 after yesterday's API sporadic errors. Renewal in ~9w. Proposal: weekly 20m office hours for triage + a monthly 90m 'health-check' workshop to drive measurable wins. Thumbs?

anna_enable: +1 for the cadence. Suggested 90m workshop agenda: 20m metrics & goals, 30m hands-on tuning (routing, batching), 25m migration/dry-run checklist, 15m action items. I can own facilitation. :white_check_mark:

mike_success: Weekly 20m OK. Ask for 5m prework from their SRE: zipped latency logs + active config. I'll prep a short A/B plan to test batching tweaks for token-cost impact.

james_se: SRE here 60 I'll draft the dry-run checklist for Private/Dedicated moves and add a curl latency capture snippet. Example for prework: ```bash
curl -sS -w "time_total:%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"input":"health-check"}'
```

olivia_csm: PM requested a 1:1 with an engineer before the first workshop to surface blockers. Also wants the first workshop to cover cost-control and graceful fallback strategies.

sarah_cs: Olivia can you run the 1:1? I'm proposing office hours slot Wed 11:00 PT, and workshop scheduled month-start (90m). Who can commit to Wed 11?

anna_enable: I can do Wed 11. I'll create the recurring invites and include a short prework checklist + deck link (internal) in the invite.

mike_success: Wed 11 works. I'll attach the A/B test plan and a simple dashboard screenshot template so PMs can see token/cost deltas quickly.

calendar-bot: Note: calendar-bot will queue invites after slot confirmation and attendee list present.

olivia_csm: Confirmed: I booked a 1:1 with Aventis PM for Tue 09:00 PT to align scope. PM asked for 3 success metrics up front (latency p50 reduction, error-rate drop, token-cost delta).

sarah_cs: Great. Action list: Olivia = 1:1 Tue 09:00 PT; Anna = schedule invites + deck + prework by EOD; James = runbook + curl snippet; Mike = A/B batching plan + dashboard. Feedback capture: 2-question form + emoji pulse after each session ("Did this unblock you?" + "Top remaining blocker?"). If >2 blockers persist, escalate to exec sponsor.

anna_enable: Will do. I'll include the feedback form link in the calendar invite (short Google form) and a Slack emoji poll after sessions. :rocket:

mike_success: I'll prepare a quick before/after snapshot to show during the workshop. Helps for renewal conversation.

sarah_cs: Thanks all 1F closing thread once invites and prework are out.
